text: Okay, like I said, the 1000-piece one is too hard. Yeah, get me one of the 500-piece beginner ones. The first one looks good, the 500 pieces, art theme, beginner difficulty. That's the one. Can you change the order to that one?
zh: 好的，就像我说的，1000片的太难了。是的，给我一个500片入门级的。第一个看起来不错，500片，艺术主题，入门难度。就是那个。你能把订单更改为那个吗？
